digest.component_or_area: build-provenance fixtures and artifact-probe CI workflow
propositions: Whole-tree build-provenance fixtures export all 3,019 checkout files but production hatch_build.py requires only three files (hook, pyproject.toml, src/rebar/__init__.py), causing repeated full-package builds across xdist workers.

The artifact-probe workflow uses GITHUB_SHA instead of deriving git rev-parse --short HEAD after final checkout, and asserts truthiness rather than exact SHA equality, allowing wrong but nonempty provenance to pass on patchsets.
Session fixture initialization repeats independently on all three xdist workers, each paying 6.60-6.74s setup overhead for redundant full builds.

Replacing whole-tree fixtures with a minimal committed Hatch package through real isolated PEP 517 sdist→wheel boundary preserves all build-hook contracts while reducing elapsed time from 18.23s to 9.11s and per-worker setup from 6.60-6.74s to 2.20-2.88s.
Both artifact workflow lanes must derive REBAR_EXPECTED_COMMIT from git rev-parse --short HEAD after their lane-specific final checkout and require exact equality for installed wheel and sdist.
